verdict.rationale: Swell's docs state that merchants can create product variations with unlimited options and attributes, with per-variant inventory tracking (swell-docs-15). Customers can pick custom options for made-to-order items (swell-docs-42). Merchants can extend the catalog with custom models and fields (swell-docs-19), and data models can add fields to existing models like products or create entirely new ones (swell-docs-31, swell-docs-32, swell-docs-9). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing/docs), and detailed API-level documentation of variant/option schemas and limits.
